capabilities: Set six palettes, accent, dark mode and card styles
Choose still gradients, moving media-art wallpapers or your own pictures
Open a style panel with sliders for glass opacity, blur, brightness, gaps and note width
Fit Dataview, Kanban and Excalidraw to the glass style
Control palette, wallpaper, motion and dark/light from the status bar
disambiguation: Not a drawing tool despite the name; it only styles the Fantasy theme with wallpapers, palettes and glass effects.
extras: Desktop only and requires Obsidian 1.13 or later; it stays idle with other themes. Disclosures cover network use for web-picture wallpapers, file:// reads, and that it lists vault file names (never note contents) to suggest picture paths.
intentEvidence: The companion plugin for the Fantasy theme: palettes, wallpapers and glass styles, set in a few clicks.
problem: The Fantasy theme's palettes, wallpapers and glass settings would otherwise need manual CSS editing instead of a few clicks.
